description: Organization emergency recovery code, v1. The code is an RK24-format value the App generates; Keeper org_emergency_seed_derive derives seed = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = Normalize(code), salt = "org:" + org_id, info = "dragpass-org-emergency-auth-v1", L = 32); ariadne stores only the Argon2id hash of the seed and signs the confirmation canonical. The same file is checked in by dragpass-keeper, ariadne and dragpass. Design: dragpass-control-plane docs/exec-plans/active/ip-allowlist-emergency-release.md section 5.2 and 5.3.

domain_separation.note: The same code, salted the same way, under the account recovery info dragpass-recovery-auth-v1. The org seed must differ from it.

invalid.reason: org_id must be a lowercase UUID
org_id is the bare UUID, the prefix is added by the derivation
O is not in the alphabet

confirm_challenge.note: dragpass.orgemergencycode|1|<org_id>|<account_id>|<code_version>|<hex sha256(seed bytes)>|<issued_at>|<expires_at>, Unix seconds. ariadne signs it at prepare; the owner's account key signs it (Keeper signchallengetoken) at confirm.
